segments.textOriginal: What do you enjoy doing on a quiet weekend?
I like taking photographs of old streets.
Where do you prefer to sit and edit photos?
I prefer quiet cafes to crowded bars.
Do you shoot more in the morning or evening?
Usually early morning, when the streets are calm.
Have you taken any interesting photos lately?
I found a beautiful old alley last weekend.
Would you like to share the story in English?
I'm practising English to talk about my photography.
We can take it slowly. Which photo would you start with?
The one with the morning light.
Would you like to describe your morning-light photo?
Yes, but I may need a little time to find the words.
Of course. What caught your eye first?
Thank you for giving me time to explain.
